system.description: This Charm permanently alters the cost of the Abyssal Excellencies associated with the Occult Ability. The First Excellency's cost becomes "one mote per two dice added," while the Second Excellency's cost becomes "one mote per success added" and the Third Excellency's cost drops to a flat three motes. Fractional values are lost. This discount only applies when the Excellency in question is channeled through the appropriate Occult Essence Flow. Supreme Perfection of Occult is incompatible with any other Charm which provides cost discounts to the Excellencies. This Charm is the Abyssal Mirror of its Solar counterpart and is identical to it in all regards.
